headline: First largely AI-run ransomware attack documented
body: A darker day. Security firm Sysdig documented JADEPUFFER, a ransomware attack in which an AI agent carried out reconnaissance, credential theft, lateral movement, encryption and the ransom note after a human picked the target. That is a step up in both Catastrophic Risk and AI Autonomy, because the AI did the dangerous work on its own. Self-Destruction, the ending where tech-fuelled catastrophe wins, rose most, Conquerors followed and Libertarian Utopia fell. Separately, Albany's council backed a one-year statewide pause on hyperscale data centers in New York, a sign of Tech Backlash that lifts Reversion slightly. Horizon Balance fell from +2.04 to +1.76.
